title: Yesterday Fun
communicative_goal: Talk about what you did yesterday using past simple regular verbs.
unit_end_capability: Learner can say I played/walked/watched yesterday.

lessons.target_language: I played. / I walked. / I watched.
lessons.objective: Name simple past actions from picture prompts.

lessons.target_language: I helped my mom. / I studied English.
lessons.objective: Describe after-school activities in the past.
Follow a short story with regular past verbs.

lessons.target_language: Yesterday I visited ___. / I painted a ___.
lessons.objective: Build a personal yesterday album with captions.

lessons.target_language: Yesterday I ___. Then I ___. Finally I ___.
